title: "UNBELIEVABLE! Ethereum's About to Pull the Surprise of the Year": Tom Lee | (New Prediction 2026)
description:
"UNBELIEVABLE! Ethereum's About to Pull the Surprise of the Year": Tom Lee | (New Prediction 2026)

Something is wrong with this crypto market, and it is not what most people think.

Ethereum is down 65% from its peak. That number hurts. But here is the detail almost nobody is talking about. Every single crypto winter in history, 2016, 2018, 2022, and 2025, happened while the stock market was also crashing by at least 20%. Every single one. This time, the S&P never broke. So what actually happened to crypto, and what does it mean for what comes next?

Tom Lee, co-founder of Fundstrat Global Advisors and the analyst who correctly called the COVID lows, the November 2022 bottom, and the April 2025 lows, is now making his most specific call yet on Ethereum. His argument is not based on sentiment or hope. 

He is pointing to a VIX and oil signal that has appeared only four times in market history, and every single time it marked a major low for equities followed by strong forward gains. He believes that signal has just appeared again. And if equities have already bottomed while the war headlines are still frightening, history says the next phase could be a bull market running all the way through 2028.

Inside that environment, Tom Lee has built a precise Ethereum price framework from two directions. The eight-year average price ratio between Ethereum and Bitcoin implies a price near $12,000. The 2021 cycle peak ratio implies $22,000. 

And in his base case, where Ethereum becomes the primary settlement layer for tokenized assets and agentic AI transactions, the number climbs toward $60,000. That target follows a composite of historical cycle lows that previously resolved into moves of 50 times and 220 times respectively.

In this video we break down exactly why Tom Lee believes this was a mini crypto winter and not a real one, what the structural difference means for the recovery timeline, why tokenization is the 1971 gold standard moment that most investors are underestimating, and why AI agents routing micro-payments through blockchain infrastructure rather than Visa or PayPal could make Ethereum the most important financial asset of the next decade.

The financial system is being rebuilt underneath us. By the time it becomes obvious, the move will already have happened.
